champion.tips: AMBESSA TIPS AND TRICKS Use your strong skirmishing power to fight the enemy whenever you can. Invade and try to steal camps to deny them XP and gold. Playing around your Ultimate R is crucial as Ambessa. Use it to your advantage to close the gap and gank your allies from afar. Try to use it whenever it is available to you. As the Jungler for your team, it is very important that you take those objectives. Try to secure Dragons, Rift Herald and every other objective whenever it is possible.
champion.builds: THE BEST AMBESSA BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR JUNGLE IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Ambessa Jungle build, you should take Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Conqueror as your keystone, followed by Triumph, Legend: Haste and Last Stand in the primary tree, as well as Magical Footwear and Cosmic Insight in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Eclipse as your first item, followed by Plated Steelcaps and Spear of Shojin. For your last 3 items, you should build Death's Dance, Black Cleaver and finish with Guardian Angel. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - E - W. Right now, this build has 46.6% winrate over 13 717 matches played. Optional Your second option for Ambessa Jungle build would be to take Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Conqueror as your keystone, Triumph, Legend: Haste and Last Stand in the primary tree, and Magical Footwear with Cosmic Insight in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health in defense. The items for the build are Voltaic Cyclosword, which you should build first, followed by Plated Steelcaps as your second item and Spear of Shojin as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Death's Dance, Maw of Malmortius and Guardian Angel. The skill order for this build is Q - E - W. In the current patch, this build has a 50.1% win rate over 5 953 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Conqueror as your keystone, Triumph, Legend: Haste and Last Stand in the primary tree, and Magical Footwear with Cosmic Insight in the secondary tree, as well as Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Hubris as your first item, then Plated Steelcaps as a second item and Sundered Sky as a third item. You want to finish the build with Death's Dance, Spear of Shojin and Guardian Angel. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - E - W. This build is currently sitting at a 50.3% win rate across 1 363 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Ambessa Jungle build in the current patch, try Flash and Smite as your Summoner Spells, Electrocute, Sudden Impact, Grisly Mementos and Treasure Hunter as your primary rune tree, and Magical Footwear with Cosmic Insight as your secondary tree. Use Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Voltaic Cyclosword as your first item, then finish Plated Steelcaps as your second item, and Spear of Shojin as third item. The last 3 options are Death's Dance, Maw of Malmortius and Guardian Angel. The ability order for this build is Q - E - W. As of the current patch, this build has a 47.1% win rate over 403 matches played. Situational Ambessa Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Ambessa build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Ambessa runes page.
